thread:
samira: Quick ask  can we combine the quarterly benefits Q&A with a tiny 'Thanks & Treats' table next Wed 12:00-1:00 in the atrium? benefits team does 15-min FAQ, then we hand out spot-award cards + small candy packs. low lift. anyone want to co-run?

people-ops: Love this hybrid idea. Micro-event cap applies. Need vendor/print costs, event owner, and payroll check on spot-award card values. Also coordinate AV for the 15-min Q&A.

eli: I can host the Q&A (quick run through open enrollment highlights + top FAQs) at 12:00, then help with cards 12:20-1:00. AV request noted.

tess: I can order 120 candy packs (~$1.50 each = $180) and print 60 spot-award cards ($30). total ~ $210. I'll submit estimate.

people-ops: Nice. payroll, quick question: if we attach a $25 value to spot-award cards, do we need to run them through payroll? Or is tracking enough?

payroll: Short answer: track recipients & value. Awards under typical de minimis thresholds usually don't need payroll processing, but we still require a CSV with recipient email + labeled award value. If any individual's annual awards >$100, we'll report it. So label cards and keep the log.

samira: great. i'll add a small note in the invite: "Small recognition items will be tracked and may be reported per company policy."

people-ops: Logistics checklist:
- eli: run 12:00-12:15 benefits Q&A (av mic + podium)
- tess: order candy & print 60 labeled spot cards ("Spot Award $25")
- samira: own event, submit vendor receipts to #expenses
- facilities: confirm atrium AV & table location
- people-ops/payroll: we will circulate a recipient CSV template to use during the event

facilities: AV confirmed (mic + small speaker). table booked near east entrance.

eli: i'll post 3 top FAQs in the invite and leave 10 minutes for live Qs. also will include a QR to the digital spot-award form for remote folks.

tess: estimate submitted to #expenses. ordering now. will bring card tray and stapler for vouchers.

people-ops: Perfect. We'll publish the invite with the brief payroll blurb and the RSVP link. Use `/spot-award` or the QR form during the event to auto-log winners. Thanks all!

samira: thanks team  excited for the combo. :sparkles:
